programmes.department: Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering
programmes.evidence: Official full doctoral policies name the actual PhD award, a formal Industrial and Systems Engineering specialization track, track-specific coursework and examination, and dissertation. The ISE department graduate page confirms joint provision and doctoral recruiting.
limitations: Operations Research appears as a possible examination topic, not a separate named doctoral route.

branches.conclusion: The current College of Business full graduate-degree menu lists the MAcc, MBA, Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence master's, Master of Science in Management, Sports Administration master's and certificates, with no doctorate. The management master's is not doctoral evidence and supplies no qualifying route.

The Russ College graduate degree finder was read on both actual pagination pages, entries 1–18 and 19–24 of 24. Its doctoral titles are Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, and Mechanical and Systems Engineering. The latter has the already verified formal Industrial and Systems Engineering track in the ISE department; the other three degree/field inventories do not add an exact qualifying route. Mathematics PhD full research-area list likewise has no Operations/Management Science named area. This is a bounded current formal-title conclusion.
